candidate_readme:
# Agent Trace

Exports each agent run as a distributed trace without changing pi core. One span is written per run, turn, provider chat, tool execution, and compaction.

## File

Spans are appended to:

```
<SessionManager.getSessionDir()>/traces/<session id>.otlp.jsonl
```

Set `PI_AGENT_TRACE_FILE` to write somewhere else. The file is JSON Lines: each line is one OTLP/JSON `ExportTraceServiceRequest` holding exactly one span:

```json
{"resourceSpans":[{"resource":{"attributes":[...]},"scopeSpans":[{"scope":{"name":"pi.agent-trace","version":"1"},"spans":[<span>]}]}]}
```

The file updates live. Every span is written twice, start line first, and never rewritten:

- **Start line** — appended when the span begins (`pi.span.phase` = `"start"`). No `endTimeUnixNano` or `status`.
- **End line** — same `traceId` / `spanId` / `parentSpanId` / `name` / `kind` / `startTimeUnixNano`, plus the remaining attributes, `endTimeUnixNano`, and `status`.

A reader that de-duplicates by `spanId` (last line wins) always holds the current trace. A span with a start line and no end line is still in progress, or was lost to a crash. Reloads and later pi processes append to the same file.

`traceId` is 32 lowercase hex characters derived from the session id (stable across reloads). `spanId` is 16 lowercase hex characters, unique per span.

## Spans

| name | kind | parent | starts / ends |
|---|---|---|---|
| `pi.run` | INTERNAL (1) | none | `agent_start` / `agent_end` |
| `pi.turn` | INTERNAL (1) | the run | `turn_start` / `turn_end` |
| `chat <model>` | CLIENT (3) | the turn | assistant `message_start` / assistant `message_end` |
| `execute_tool <tool name>` | INTERNAL (1) | the turn | `tool_execution_start` / `tool_execution_end` |
| `pi.compaction` | INTERNAL (1) | none | `session_before_compact` / `session_compact` or `session_compact_failed` |

Entry ids are written on end lines only, once pi has persisted the matching session entry. Tool calls of one assistant message are concurrent children of the turn.

Status is ERROR for a tool with `isError`, an assistant/`pi.turn` whose `stopReason` is `error` or `aborted`, a failed compaction, and every span still open on `session_shutdown` (message `"shutdown"`). Runs stay OK even when a turn inside them failed.

## Usage

```bash
pi -e packages/coding-agent/examples/extensions/agent-trace
```

Or copy `index.ts` to `~/.pi/agent/extensions/agent-trace/` (a directory with `index.ts` loads through `DefaultResourceLoader`). Point an OTLP-aware collector or viewer at the JSONL file.
